cover.headline: GAMECLOCKED! No. 500 Was a Lousy Homecoming In The Swamp
cover.dek: A lousy Homecoming for the 500th game in The Swamp, and why Buddy is still hanging on with Jon Sumrall.

image.alt: Florida coach Jon Sumrall, in a blue Gators cap and short-sleeve hoodie, walks toward the field before the South Carolina game at Ben Hill Griffin Stadium
image.credit: Photo by Chris Spears, GatorBait Media

lines: Franz Beard: Can the season be salvaged?

damage.title: The damage
damage.dek: Florida came in scoring 53.5 points and gaining 532.8 yards a game. The yardage was nearly even Saturday. The gap was turnovers, third downs and LaNorris Sellers.

stats.label: Florida turnovers
stats.detail: 2 interceptions, 1 fumble lost. South Carolina had none

stats.label: Second-half score
stats.detail: South Carolina led 17-10 at the half

flow.title: How the game turned
flow.dek: Florida's chance to win, play by play. The Gators peaked at 85% in the first quarter and were level at 10-10 late in the second. South Carolina outscored them 28-9 the rest of the way.

marks.note: Florida's high point, 6:00 left in the first quarter
South Carolina's Orsan kicks a 37-yard field goal with 4:09 left in the half
Sellers to Bennett with 1:47 left in the half; Florida falls to 46%
Sellers runs it in from the 1 with 1:08 left in the third; Florida is at 4%

flow.summary: Line chart of Florida's win probability against South Carolina. It starts near 73%, peaks at 85% in the first quarter, holds near 70% at 10-10, falls to about 46% when South Carolina goes up 17-10 before halftime, drops to 4% by 31-13 late in the third quarter and sits near zero through the fourth.
flow.source: Win probability: ESPN. GatorBait Media graphic.

items.text: I'm frustrated with every part of what we did today. It starts with me.
I think it's a player thing right now. I don't think it has anything to do with the coaches.
We've lost two games, man. I don't believe it's the end of the world.

texas.title: Texas lost on a last-second field goal
texas.dek: Oklahoma beat Texas 27-24 in the Red River Rivalry at the Cotton Bowl in Dallas. Texas led 17-7 at the half. Arch Manning's 15-yard touchdown pass tied it 24-24 with 6:32 left, and Tate Sandell kicked a 47-yard field goal as time expired.
